{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows mean reversion (true outcome < model forecast for 3+ consecutive days).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high sentiment (sentiment > 0.33) by applying a 10-15% upward bias to correct for lagged reactions.",
    "Apply a 5-10% downward correction if model forecast exceeds true outcome by >15% and sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "If sentiment is positive (≥ 0.33) and model forecast is below true outcome, apply a 5-10% upward adjustment to capture momentum.",
    "For spikes in true outcome, apply a 10-20% lag correction in subsequent forecasts to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment is volatile (alternating +/– 0.33), use a 5% smoothing filter to reduce noise in forecast adjustments."
  ]
}
